original_objective: Clean the raw customer snapshot and analyse churn: the overall churn rate, differences between plans, signup cohorts and contract types, an at-risk segment with many support tickets and low satisfaction, lifetime value by plan, and the distribution of tenure and satisfaction, then report the verified findings to business stakeholders.

cleaning.cleaning_logic: The script performs 12 cleaning steps in order: (R1) reads raw CSV as text, strips whitespace, and standardizes missing values; (R2) removes duplicate customer_id records keeping first occurrence; (R3) parses signup_date using 5 date formats and outputs as YYYY-MM-DD; (R4) maps plan variants to Basic/Standard/Premium; (R5) maps contract_type variants to Monthly/Annual; (R6) cleans monthly_fee by removing currency symbols and validates range 0.01-500; (R7) parses tenure_months removing 'month(s)' suffix and validates range 0-120; (R8) sets missing support_tickets to 0 and validates range 0-100; (R9) validates satisfaction_score as integer 1-5, keeping rows with missing values; (R10) maps churned variants to 0/1; (R11) calculates lifetime_value as monthly_fee * tenure_months; (R12) outputs sorted data with specified column order.
